description: Rice is a staple food crop grown in flooded fields. The cultivation cost is around ₹25,000–₹40,000 including seeds, fertilizers, irrigation, and labor.
grow: Rice grows in hot, humid climate. Sowing is done in June–July or November–December. Seedlings are transplanted after 20–25 days and harvested in 120–150 days.

description: Wheat is a major winter cereal crop. It requires 1 acre of land and costs ₹18,000–₹30,000 per acre for cultivation.
grow: Wheat grows in cool climate. Sowing is done in October–November. Seeds are sown directly, irrigated at critical stages, and harvested after 110–130 days.

description: Mung bean is a short-duration pulse crop rich in protein. One acre costs around ₹10,000–₹18,000 to cultivate.
grow: It grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in February–March or June–July. Seeds are directly sown and harvested after 60–70 days.

description: Tea is a plantation crop grown for leaves. Initial investment is high, about ₹1,50,000 per acre.
grow: Tea grows in cool and humid climate. Planting is done in June–July. Regular irrigation and pruning are required. Leaves are plucked after 2–3 years.

description: Millet is a drought-resistant cereal crop requiring low water. One acre costs ₹8,000–₹15,000.
grow: Millet grows in dry regions. Sowing is done in June–July. Minimal irrigation is needed and harvest is after 70–90 days.

description: Maize is used as food and fodder. One acre cultivation costs ₹15,000–₹25,000.
grow: Maize grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July or October. Harvest is after 90–110 days.

description: Lentil is a winter pulse crop rich in nutrients. One acre costs ₹12,000–₹20,000.
grow: It grows in cool climate. Sowing is done in October–November and harvested after 110–120 days.

description: Jute is a fiber crop used for making bags and ropes. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹30,000.
grow: Jute grows in warm and humid climate. Sowing is done in March–April and harvested after 120–130 days.

description: Coffee is a beverage crop grown under shade. One acre establishment costs about ₹1,20,000.
grow: Coffee grows in warm climate with shade. Planting is done in June–August. Harvesting starts after 3–4 years.

description: Cotton is a fiber crop used in textile industry. One acre costs ₹30,000–₹50,000.
grow: Cotton grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in May–June and harvested after 160–180 days.

description: Groundnut is an oilseed crop rich in protein. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹30,000.
grow: Groundnut grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July or January. Harvest after 100–120 days.

description: Peas are protein-rich vegetables grown in winter. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹30,000.
grow: Peas grow in cool climate. Sowing is done in October–November. Harvest after 60–70 days.

description: Rubber is a plantation crop grown for latex. Initial cost is around ₹2,00,000 per acre.
grow: Rubber grows in hot and humid climate. Planting is done in June–July. Latex tapping starts after 6–7 years.

description: Sugarcane is a long-duration cash crop. One acre costs ₹40,000–₹70,000.
grow: Sugarcane grows in hot climate. Planting is done from January–March and harvested after 10–12 months.

description: Tobacco is a commercial crop grown for leaves. One acre costs ₹25,000–₹40,000.
grow: Tobacco grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in October–November and harvested after 120–150 days.

description: Kidney beans are protein-rich pulses. One acre costs ₹15,000–₹25,000.
grow: They grow in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July. Harvest after 90–100 days.

description: Moth beans are drought-resistant pulses. One acre costs ₹8,000–₹12,000.
grow: They grow in hot and dry regions. Sowing is done in July and harvested after 70–80 days.

description: Coconut is a multipurpose plantation crop. One acre initial cost is ₹1,00,000–₹1,50,000.
grow: Coconut grows in tropical coastal climate. Planting is done in June–July. Yield starts after 5–6 years.

description: Black gram is a popular pulse crop. One acre costs ₹10,000–₹18,000.
grow: It grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July or February–March. Harvest after 70–80 days.

description: Adzuki beans are small red pulses. One acre costs ₹15,000–₹25,000.
grow: They grow in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July and harvested after 90 days.

description: Pigeon peas are long-duration pulses. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹30,000.
grow: They grow in semi-arid regions. Sowing is done in June–July and harvested after 150–180 days.

description: Chickpea is a nutritious winter pulse crop. One acre costs ₹15,000–₹25,000.
grow: Chickpea grows in cool and dry climate. Sowing is done in October–November and harvested after 100–120 days.

description: Banana is a high-yield fruit crop. One acre costs ₹60,000–₹1,00,000.
grow: Banana grows in warm and humid climate. Planting is done in June–July. Harvest after 11–14 months.

description: Grapes are grown for table and wine purpose. One acre costs ₹1,00,000–₹1,50,000.
grow: Grapes grow in dry climate. Planting is done in January–February. Harvest after 8–9 months.

description: Apple is a temperate fruit crop. One acre costs ₹1,50,000–₹2,00,000.
grow: Apple grows in cold climate. Planting is done in January–February. Fruiting starts after 4–5 years.

description: Mango is a long-term fruit crop. One acre costs ₹50,000–₹80,000 initially.
grow: Mango grows in tropical climate. Planting is done in June–August. Fruiting starts after 4–5 years.

description: Muskmelon is a summer fruit crop. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹30,000.
grow: Muskmelon grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in January–February. Harvest after 80–90 days.

description: Orange is a citrus fruit crop. One acre costs ₹70,000–₹1,00,000.
grow: Orange grows in mild tropical climate. Planting is done in June–July. Fruiting starts after 3–4 years.

description: Papaya is a fast-growing fruit crop. One acre costs ₹40,000–₹60,000.
grow: Papaya grows in warm climate. Sowing is done in June–July. Harvest starts after 8–10 months.

description: Pomegranate is a drought-tolerant fruit crop. One acre costs ₹60,000–₹90,000.
grow: Pomegranate grows in semi-arid climate. Planting is done in June–July. Harvest after 2–3 years.

description: Watermelon is a summer fruit crop. One acre costs ₹20,000–₹35,000.
grow: Watermelon grows in hot climate. Sowing is done in January–February. Harvest after 80–90 days.
